Updated after the games on 2026-10-28: 79 completed EuroCup games; Round 5 is still in progress. Season averages use official completed-game data only. Proj PIR, matchup difficulty and option score are model estimates, not actual results. Team context is current-season only.

Method

GP, minutes, PIR, points, shooting, rebounds and assists are observed statistics from official completed EuroCup games. Prices, ownership and injury status are the current public fantasy snapshot. Players with no current-season minutes have no projection or playing-time fallback.
Proj PIR is a model, not an actual score. It combines current PIR/min × projected current minutes, a price-based small-sample prior (weight fades by 5 games), next-opponent pace, real-points DvP, home/away and risk adjustments. No previous-season player statistics enter this calculation.
Team context uses only the current EuroCup season. Pace estimates possessions as FGA + 0.44×FTA − OREB + TOV, averaged with the opponent. Shot Share = player FGA/game ÷ team FGA/game × 100. DvP shows real points, grouped by fantasy G/F/C positions (official positions only for players missing from the fantasy list). Samples of two or three games are very small.
